test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: S alone can do a piece of work in 14 days. T alone can do the same work in 21 days. U alone can do the same work in 28 days. Working together, in how many days will they complete the work?
solution:
Given:

Number of days taken by S to complete the work = 14 days

Number of days taken by T to complete the work = 21 days

Number of days taken by U to complete the work = 28 days

Calculation:

Work done by S in each day = (1)/(14) units/day

Work done by T in each day = (1)/(21) units/day

Work done by U in each day = (1)/(28) units/day

Work done together by S, T and U each day = (1)/(14)+(1)/(21)+(1)/(28)

Taking LCM of the denominators, we get

Work done together by S, T and U each day

= (6+4+3)/(84)=(13)/(84) units/day

So, whole work completed by S, T and U working together in = (1)/(frac{13){84}}=(84)/(13) days

Hence, required number of days to complete the work is (84)/(13) days.
